title: 蓄水楼 Xushui Lou
subtitle: Hsu Shui Lou, Building for Gathering the Waters · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace: position and footprint from the ruin, the plan or a survey, heights read from the plates of the 1780s (research/xiyanglou/boxes.csv). Not a detailed model yet; the figures and their methods are in the Dimensions block.

questions.title: The plan's scale and turn in this strip (Round 6)

evidence.title: Test of the claim that the fountains stopped when Benoist died in 1774
evidence.summary: Result: the common form of the claim is wrong in two ways. (1) The machines failed before Benoist died: the wheel broke in 1763 and windlasses replaced it. (2) The fountains did not stop: reports of 1786 and 1789 have men filling the reservoir a day or two before a visit so that the water could play for the emperor (Bourgeois); wicker buckets from the river (Amiot); pipes repaired 1794, Dutch envoys meant to see the 水法 in early 1795 (E0185); machines scrapped 1795, but 嘉庆's poems of 1796-98 still mention water sent by machine: poetry, weak. Holding: after 1763 or so the fountains ran on occasion with stored water, carried by labour.

evidence.title: 内庭圆明园内工诸作现行则例, 水车则例; 西洋水法铸造激筒铜管等项活计按例应用物料匠夫则例
evidence.summary: Two Qing building-rule texts list the parts of the water machines with their materials; Katsu matches them part by part with Belidor's Architecture Hydraulique. Primary texts held in China; a wish for their sizes.

evidence.title: Plate III: 蓄水楼 Xushui Lou
evidence.excerpt_other: C'est un corps-de-logis composé d'un rez-de-chaussée, et d'un étage; celui-ci percé de cinq fenêtres, celui-là de quatre fenêtres et d'une porte.
evidence.summary: Titled Château-d'eau, or Machine du Val-Saint-Pierre. Five windows above, four and a door below, a one-storey wing, clipped shrubs on lawns.

evidence.title: Engraving 3: 蓄水楼 Xushui Lou
evidence.excerpt_other: A small two-story building with a northern wing of one story faced eastward on the courtyard north of Number Two.
evidence.summary: Small two-storey water building with a one-storey north wing, facing east.

evidence.title: Bourgeois 1786: the fountains after Benoist
evidence.excerpt_other: un ou deux jours auparavant, on emploie tant de monde à porter l'eau que le bassin immense du château d'eau est suffisamment rempli, et les eaux jouent sur le passage de l'Empereur.
evidence.summary: Benoist's machine had worn out and was not repaired. Men filled the reservoir a day or two before the emperor's visit. Main pipes as thick as a man's body, medium and large ones of copper.

evidence.title: Engraving 4: 花园门 Huayuan Men
evidence.excerpt_other: The wall was of gray brick cut smooth and decorated with a large pattern in pink and a deep cream tint.
evidence.summary: North side of the maze gate, seen from inside; 蓄水楼 visible over the wall. Wall colours as quoted, source of the colours not stated.

evidence.title: 线法桥
evidence.locator: zh.wikipedia 圆明园, 西洋楼 section
evidence.summary: South of 蓄水楼 against the west wall of 长春园: five arches with beast faces spouting water, and a false door with a large Western clock in the centre, carved walls either side. Parts were later moved to Yenching University. A lead: not seen on a Qing source. No engraving of the 20 is named for it.

evidence.title: 圆明园水利文物遗迹研究
evidence.summary: Inventory of water works: the 藻园 one-arch inlet, main source, now buried under the wall and undug; 黄花阵 inlet with good piers; 鉴碧亭 sluice, abandoned 2007; 狮子林 七孔闸, chief outlet, buried in the 2000s behind a new weir with only a stub showing; west water tower fed from a three-arch inlet.

evidence.title: 谐奇趣样式雷图
evidence.locator: 故宫博物院图书馆 样986号
evidence.summary: Undated design and survey sketch with the perspective bridge, the water tower, the aviary and Xieqi Qu. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

evidence.title: 西水车房内檐平面图
evidence.summary: Interior fittings plan of the western waterwheel house, 蓄水楼. Page text gives 5 bays facing east, a 3-bay platform room to the north, an upper tank, and 1763 change from mules to men with windlasses, from archives.

evidence.title: 谐奇趣样式雷图 (样986), 朱墨 底样, 设计与踏勘草图
evidence.locator: 故宫博物院图书馆 样986号
evidence.summary: Update to E0935: red lines mark three supply pipes from 蓄水楼 to 谐奇趣's pools; on the right, field notes of a two-storey elevation, a fountain, and a five-arch sluice elevation. Useful for the pipe run and the 线法桥 sluice.

evidence.title: 谐奇趣平面图, 墨线 底样
evidence.locator: 故宫博物院图书馆 样985号
evidence.summary: Ink base plan of 谐奇趣 and its fountains. No. 985 at the Palace Museum library per S310; this is the number S108 cites as the sheet with over 120 dimensions, placing it at the National Library. No figures from it are public.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.

evidence.title: Copper pipe dug up near 谐奇趣; red line on a 样式房 plan as water route
evidence.locator: lecture of 郭黛姮 as reported
evidence.summary: A Forbidden City 样式房 plan of 谐奇趣 has red lines, which she reads as water routes. Ground-penetrating radar found pipes, and a dig found a well-kept copper pipe. Schlimme's Benoist letter names a hydraulic-machine book whose figure matches the central axle visible through a half-open window on a plate. Independent backing for S600's Belidor.

reconstructions.title: Fig. 4, Plan d'ensemble (plan de restitution 1985)
reconstructions.creator: Antoine Durand
reconstructions.archive: Mission Palais d'Ete, under Michele Pirazzoli-t'Serstevens
reconstructions.why: Three stages: 1984 plan from Jin Xun's plan fragments in Adam 1936, on the 1:10,000 park plan at 1:500, corrected by site readings and engravings; 1985 plan from a survey of the whole site, with general dimensions and setting of each building; water theatre from a Lei family drawing, Alimoff photo for the west basin of 海晏堂, engravings for planting.
reconstructions.licence: none stated on the Persee page

reconstructions.title: Digital restoration research and 3D model of Xieqiqu, ISPRS Annals II-5/W3
reconstructions.creator: M. Gao, W. Piao, J. Guo
reconstructions.why: The Yuanmingyuan Digital Restoration Research Project of 2013 covered five of thirteen 西洋楼 scenes in its first two years: 谐奇趣, 海晏堂, 方外观, 蓄水楼, 观水法. The paper explains 谐奇趣's method: present-day survey with archival drawings and engravings.
reconstructions.licence: CC BY 3.0 on the paper; Figs 2, 4b, 5, 7, 8a, 10 and 11 credited elsewhere; the free figures have their own rows

reconstructions.creator: Shingei Katsu
reconstructions.why: Jesuit letters, Belidor's Architecture Hydraulique, Taixi shuifa of 1612 and two Qing documents; a reading of how Benoist's design was actually built.
